summary: RELX is an Anglo-Dutch multinational publishing and information company co-headquartered in London, United Kingdom and Amsterdam, Netherlands, founded in 1993. Type: listed company. Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 12 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about acquisitions; 3 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: Anglo-Dutch information and analytics group (including Elsevier) with roles shared between Amsterdam and London; all jobs are in English and show pay.

culture.text: Work focuses on helping researchers and healthcare professionals with content and analytics, for example at its Elsevier business.
Most of its 12 jobs are senior or director level, often in product and project management, and many are shared between Amsterdam and London.
Describes a culture of ownership, accountability, constant improvement and inclusion.
A Dutch trade outlet ran an interview with a RELX corporate tax specialist about her work there.

open.text: None of its 12 jobs here require Dutch, and all of them show the pay.
Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor, and no jobs mention visa support.

growth.text: Founded in 1993, co-headquartered in London and Amsterdam and listed in New York, London and Amsterdam.
Launched a £125 million buyback of its own shares.

worth_knowing.text: Ongoing debate about whether AI threatens its data and information business.
The Dutch legal entity is RELX N.V.; the ultimate owner is RELX PLC in the UK.
